dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Tell me what happened to your ankle.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: I slipped on the stairs yesterday evening and landed badly on my left foot. My ankle twisted under me.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: The ankle became swollen quite quickly after the fall, especially around the outside.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: It also turned purple this morning. There is a big bruise near the ankle.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Were you able to stand immediately after the accident?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: Yes, but it hurt. I can still walk now, although I have to move slowly because putting weight on the foot is painful.

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: We put ice on it several times and kept the foot raised during the night.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Have you taken anything for the pain?

dialogue.speaker: parent
dialogue.text: He took ibuprofen once last night and another dose this morning.

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: It helped a little, but the ankle still hurts when I walk.

dialogue.speaker: child
dialogue.text: He could barely get down the stairs this morning.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: Did you injure your knee or hit your head when you fell?

dialogue.speaker: patient
dialogue.text: No. Only the ankle seems to be injured.

dialogue.speaker: doctor
dialogue.text: I will examine where the ankle is tender and decide whether we need an X-ray.
